name: EditorConfig file present with required settings
description: Solution root must contain .editorconfig with indent_style=space, charset=utf-8-bom, end_of_line=crlf, indent_size=4, insert_final_newline=false, dotnet_sort_system_directives_first=true.

assertions.check: A file named .editorconfig exists at solution root and contains the listed key=value settings.

name: 4-space indentation for C#
description: C# source files use 4-space indentation.

assertions.check: No tab characters used for indentation; indent unit is 4 spaces (delegable to .editorconfig/analyzer).

name: Braces required for control structures
description: All control structures (if/for/foreach/while) must use braces, except expression-bodied members.

assertions.check: No single-statement if/for/foreach/while without braces (Roslyn IDE0011 equivalent).

name: Prefer lines under 120 characters
description: Source lines should not exceed 120 characters.

assertions.check: No line exceeds 120 characters.

name: Using directive ordering and placement
description: using directives outside namespace, System.* first, no unused usings, file-scoped namespaces (C# 10+).

assertions.check: using directives precede namespace declaration, System namespaces sorted first, zero unused usings (IDE0005).

name: File-scoped namespaces required
description: C# files must use file-scoped namespace declarations.

assertions.check: No block-scoped `namespace X { }` declarations; only `namespace X;` form used.

name: Identifier capitalization conventions
description: Namespace/Class/Method/Property/PublicField/Constant/EnumType/EnumValue = PascalCase; Interface = IPascalCase; PrivateField = _camelCase; Parameter/LocalVariable = camelCase.

assertions.check: Identifier casing matches the declared kind per the capitalization table.

name: Async methods suffixed Async
description: All async methods must be suffixed with Async.

assertions.check: Every method declared `async` or returning Task/Task<T> intended as async has an identifier ending in "Async".

name: Acronym casing convention
description: Two-letter acronyms (Id, Db, Ui) treated as a single word; longer acronyms are PascalCase, not all-caps.

assertions.check: No identifiers contain all-caps acronym runs of length >=2 that should be PascalCase (e.g. ID, URL, HTTP).

name: Class member ordering
description: Constants, private fields, constructors, public properties, public methods, private methods, in that order.

assertions.check: Class member declaration order matches: const -> private field -> ctor -> public property -> public method -> private method.

name: API-facing enums use JsonStringEnumConverter
description: Enums exposed via API use [JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))]; default/unknown value starts at 0.

assertions.check: Public API enum types carry [JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))] and first member value is 0.

name: Nullable reference types enabled
description: <Nullable>enable</Nullable> required in all projects.

assertions.check: <Nullable>enable</Nullable> present in every .csproj.

name: Custom exceptions follow standard shape
description: Custom exceptions inherit from Exception/standard types and provide constructor overloads.

assertions.check: Types named *Exception derive from System.Exception (or subclass) and declare the standard 4 constructor overloads.

name: No blocking async calls
description: Async methods return Task/Task<T>, never void (except event handlers); no async void; no .Result/.Wait().

assertions.check: No `async void` outside designated event-handler signatures; no `.Result` or `.Wait()` call sites on Task/Task<T>.

name: Constructor injection only, <5 params, readonly fields
description: Constructor injection only; constructor parameter count < 5; dependencies stored in readonly fields; no service-locator pattern.

assertions.check: Constructor parameter count < 5; injected dependency fields declared readonly; no calls to IServiceProvider.GetService/GetRequiredService outside DI extension methods.

name: Strongly-typed validated configuration
description: Configuration bound to IOptions<T>, validated at startup via .ValidateDataAnnotations().ValidateOnStart().

assertions.check: Every AddOptions<T>() registration chain includes .ValidateDataAnnotations().ValidateOnStart().

name: Mandatory NuGet packages present
description: PP.Framework.DDD.v2, PP.Framework.Http, Microsoft.AspNetCore.App, Microsoft.Extensions.* referenced as applicable.

assertions.check: Required PackageReference entries present per project role.

name: Forbidden NuGet packages absent
description: AutoMapper, FluentValidation, Moq (or other mocking frameworks), Dapper, Hangfire, NLog must never be referenced.
remediation: Remove the PackageReference and use the PayPoint-approved alternative (e.g. hand-crafted mappers instead of AutoMapper).

assertions.check: No PackageReference to AutoMapper, FluentValidation, Moq, NSubstitute, Dapper, Hangfire, or NLog.

name: No mocking frameworks in tests
description: Moq and other mocking frameworks forbidden; xUnit is required; xUnit assertions only, not FluentAssertions.
remediation: comparison-matrix.md and template-extraction.md mark FluentAssertions/Moq/NSubstitute as compliant/scaffolded, but golden-standard.md and coding-standards.md forbid them and take priority per standards/index.md; treat the ban as authoritative.

assertions.check: No PackageReference to Moq, NSubstitute, or FluentAssertions in test projects; xunit package present.

name: Manual test double folder convention
description: Hand-crafted test doubles live in a Doubles/ folder in test projects.

assertions.check: Test project contains a Doubles/ folder when hand-crafted test doubles are used.

name: Test naming convention
description: Test methods named MethodName_Scenario_ExpectedBehavior.

assertions.check: Test method identifiers match ^[A-Za-z0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9]+$.

name: No obsolete AddFrameworkInstrumentation call
description: Do not use the obsolete AddFrameworkInstrumentation API.

assertions.check: No call sites of AddFrameworkInstrumentation.

name: Prefer Any() over Count() > 0; avoid blocking calls
description: Avoid Task.Result/.Wait(); use Any() instead of Count() > 0.

assertions.check: No `.Count() > 0` pattern where `.Any()` should be used; no `.Result`/`.Wait()` call sites.

name: Use IHttpClientFactory
description: Use IHttpClientFactory; reuse HttpClient instances; set timeouts.

assertions.check: No `new HttpClient()` instantiation outside DI/factory registration.

name: EventHandler.Application requires EventLimiting folder
description: *.EventHandler.Application projects must include an EventLimiting/ middleware folder.

assertions.check: Folder EventLimiting/ exists under every *.EventHandler.Application project.

name: API routes versioned in URL path
description: API versioning appears in the URL path, e.g. /v1/....

assertions.check: Route templates match ^/v[0-9]+/ or ^/api/v[0-9]+/.

name: XML documentation present on public APIs
description: Public APIs carry XML documentation (summary/param/returns).

assertions.check: Public members have a preceding /// <summary> doc comment block.

name: Standard repository layout
description: Expected repo layout: src/, per-layer projects named {ServiceName}.Service.Application/.Domain/.Persistence/.Schemas/.EventHandler.Application, matching test projects, .Reporting.*, .Shared, .Shared.Tests, .AppHost, .TestWebsite, nuget.config.

assertions.check: Required project folders/files exist under src/ matching the naming template.

name: requirements/ folder per environment
description: requirements/ folder structured per environment (base, dev, sandbox, uat, preprodsuk/wuk, prodsuk/wuk, infrastructure/) with Bruno collections.

assertions.check: requirements/ contains the listed environment subfolders.

name: Mandatory root files
description: Root files required: azure-pipelines.yaml, azure-pipelines-pr.yaml, .editorconfig, .gitignore, README.md.

assertions.check: Each listed root file exists.

name: Prefer .slnx over .sln
description: Solutions should use .slnx; if both exist, .sln must be removed.

assertions.check: No .sln file present alongside a .slnx file.

name: Solution folder naming has no service-name prefix
description: Solution folder names must not be prefixed with the service name.

assertions.check: Solution folder elements in the .slnx XML do not start with the service name.

name: Region naming convention
description: Region suffixes (suk, wuk) align with ppp-{env}-{region}-{resource-type}.

assertions.check: Resource names match ^ppp-[a-z]+-(suk|wuk)-[a-z-]+$.

name: Layer dependency direction enforced
description: Domain has zero infra deps; Application depends only on Domain interfaces; API never directly references Domain/Persistence; Persistence implements Domain interfaces.

assertions.check: ProjectReference graph matches the allowed layer dependency matrix; no disallowed cross-layer reference exists.

name: Entity/event data are records with required properties
description: Entity/event data types are record types with required properties.

assertions.check: *EntityData / *EventData types are declared `record` and use `required` on mandatory properties.

name: Event naming convention
description: Events named {Entity}{Action}Event.

assertions.check: Event type names match ^[A-Za-z]+(Created|Updated|Deleted|[A-Za-z]+)Event$.

name: Event structure: base record with Audit and Version
description: Abstract base record carries Audit + Version; derived event records are sealed.

assertions.check: Event base record declares Audit and Version members; concrete event records are `sealed`.

name: Repositories extend DomainEntityRepository<>
description: Repositories must extend DomainEntityRepository<> from PP.Framework.DDD.v2; no wrapper methods that just delegate to the base class; interface lives only in Domain.

assertions.check: Repository classes derive from DomainEntityRepository<>; no method body that only calls base.<SameMethod>(...) with no added logic; repository interface not redeclared in the Persistence project.

name: Reporting persistence uses PP.Framework.SPP.Reporting.DbUp
description: Reporting uses PP.Framework.SPP.Reporting.DbUp, not bare DbUp or EF Migrations.

assertions.check: No reference to bare dbup-core/dbup-sqlserver or Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore packages in Reporting.Persistence projects.

name: DbUp script naming convention
description: RunOnce/{NNN}_{description}.sql, RunAlways/{EntityName}_{Operation}.sql; no usp_/sp_ filename prefixes.

assertions.check: Filenames under RunOnce/ match ^[0-9]{3}_.+\.sql$; filenames under RunAlways/ match ^[A-Za-z]+_[A-Za-z]+\.sql$; no filename starts with usp_ or sp_.

name: Minimal APIs only, no MVC controllers
description: ASP.NET Core Minimal APIs required; MVC controllers ([ApiController]/ControllerBase) forbidden.

assertions.check: No class decorated with [ApiController] or deriving from ControllerBase.

name: Routes versioned /api/v{version}/{resource}
description: Routes follow /api/v{version}/{resource}; RFC 7807 Problem Details for all errors.

assertions.check: Route templates match ^/api/v[0-9]+/; error responses use ProblemDetails type.

name: Schemas project is pure transport contracts
description: *.Schemas project has zero NuGet/behavior deps; all contracts sealed record; request props use [Required] with safe defaults and must NOT use required keyword; response/event props use required+init with no data-annotation attributes; one type per file matching filename.

assertions.check: *.Schemas.csproj has zero PackageReference entries; every type is sealed record; request records use [Required] not `required`; response/event records use `required`+`init` and no DataAnnotations attributes; file name matches the single type declared in it.

name: Only [Required] allowed on request schemas
description: No [StringLength]/[Range]/[MinLength] etc. on request schema properties; business rules belong in domain factories.

assertions.check: No [StringLength]/[Range]/[MinLength]/[RegularExpression] attributes present on *.Schemas request record properties.

name: Outbound HTTP must use PP.Framework.Http
description: No custom HttpClient subclasses/SendRequest wrappers/bespoke telemetry; *.Shared must not contain bespoke HTTP infra.

assertions.check: No class subclassing HttpClient or reimplementing a `SendRequest` wrapper; *.Shared project contains no such types.

name: launchSettings.json required per application project
description: launchSettings.json required in Properties/ for every *.Application/*.EventHandler.Application project with http/https profiles and ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development.

assertions.check: Properties/launchSettings.json exists with http and https profiles and ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development.

name: Port assignment ranges by service type

assertions.check: applicationUrl ports in launchSettings.json fall within the documented range for the service's role.

name: Domain layer has no infrastructure dependencies
description: Domain code must not reference HttpClient/SqlConnection/infra types.

assertions.check: No `using System.Net.Http;`, `using Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos;`, or SqlConnection references in *.Domain project files.

name: No mixed Cosmos/SQL persistence per project
description: Cosmos-only in *.Persistence, SQL-only in *.Reporting.Persistence, never mixed.

assertions.check: *.Persistence projects reference only Cosmos packages; *.Reporting.Persistence projects reference only SQL packages, never both in the same project.

name: Event route strings are named constants
description: Event route strings must be public static class constants, not inlined literals.

assertions.check: No string literal route argument passed directly to MapPost/MapGet for event routes; a named constant/class member is used instead.

name: Canonical Audit model fields
description: Audit model fields fixed: Username, Name, UserId, ApplicationId, ApplicationName, Operation, DateRequested.

assertions.check: Audit record declares exactly the listed member set.

name: Configuration source hierarchy
description: appsettings.json -> appsettings.{Env}.json -> env vars (__ separator) -> Key Vault/Managed Identity.

assertions.check: ConfigurationBuilder/WebApplicationBuilder configuration source order matches the documented hierarchy.

name: No secrets committed to source control
description: No secrets in source control; none in requirements/.

assertions.check: Secret-scanning finds no credential-shaped values in tracked files, especially under requirements/.

name: DI registration extension method naming
description: Registration extension methods named Add{Feature}; no service locator; constructor injection only.

assertions.check: Public static IServiceCollection extension methods for registration are named Add{Feature}.

name: No Console.WriteLine in production code
description: ILogger<T> required; Console.WriteLine forbidden in production code.

assertions.check: No Console.WriteLine/Console.Write call sites outside test or console-tool projects.

name: /health and /ready endpoints required
description: /health and /ready endpoints via PP.Framework.HealthChecks.

assertions.check: Program.cs calls MapHealthChecks("/health") and a readiness endpoint equivalent to /ready.

name: Test naming convention (golden standard)
description: {MethodName}_{Scenario}_{ExpectedOutcome}.

assertions.check: Test method identifiers match ^[A-Za-z0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9]+_[A-Za-z0-9]+$.

name: xUnit only, no FluentAssertions/Moq/NSubstitute
description: xUnit only; no FluentAssertions; no Moq/NSubstitute (manual test doubles required).
remediation: See coding.test.no-mocking-frameworks for the corpus-inconsistency note.

assertions.check: No PackageReference to FluentAssertions, Moq, or NSubstitute in *.Tests projects.

name: coverlet.msbuild mandatory in test projects
description: coverlet.msbuild mandatory; coverlet.collector recommended.

assertions.check: Test project references coverlet.msbuild package.

name: TreatWarningsAsErrors required
description: <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors> required in all csproj files.

assertions.check: <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors> present in every .csproj.

name: Pipeline file naming convention
description: azure-pipelines.yaml (full CI/CD), azure-pipelines-pr.yaml (build validation only).

assertions.check: Both azure-pipelines.yaml and azure-pipelines-pr.yaml exist at repo root.

name: Product repos must not contain a Dockerfile
description: Dockerfile ownership belongs to shared pipeline templates; presence in a product repo is a violation.

assertions.check: No file named Dockerfile exists anywhere in the product repository.

name: No EF Core for operational data
description: Core framework fixed: Cosmos SDK + DbUp (no EF Core for operational data).

assertions.check: No Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore* package reference in *.Persistence (non-Reporting) projects.

name: Mandatory PayPoint framework libraries
description: DDD.v2, DDD.v2.CosmosDB, Logging.Microsoft, Instrumentation, HealthChecks, Http, Http.Extensions, SPP.Reporting.DbUp, IdGenerator, FpeUtility referenced as applicable.

assertions.check: Required PP.Framework.* package references present per project role.

name: Fixed severity vocabulary for AI findings
description: Exactly four severity levels allowed: BLOCKER, REQUIRED, SUGGESTED, INFO.

assertions.check: Every finding's severity field is one of BLOCKER, REQUIRED, SUGGESTED, INFO.

name: Suppress findings for approved deviations
description: Must not raise a finding for deviations already marked Approved/Resolved in deviations-report.md.

assertions.check: No finding references a location/deviation ID whose status in deviations-report.md is Approved or Resolved.

name: Fixed finding report structure
description: FINDING-{NNN} with Severity/Standard/File/Deviation ID/Description/Before/After/Action.

assertions.check: Each finding block matches the documented FINDING-{NNN} template fields.

name: Standards freshness thresholds
description: golden-standard.md stale after 90 days (30 for architecture sections); coding-standards.md stale after 14 days; deviations-report.md stale after 30 days.

assertions.check: Agent emits a staleness warning when a document's Last-Updated metadata exceeds its threshold.

name: No unconfirmed edits to protected standards docs
description: golden-standard.md/repository-blueprint.yaml/comparison-matrix.md/deviations-report.md must not be modified without engineer confirmation.

assertions.check: No write operation to the listed files occurs without an explicit prior engineer confirmation step recorded.

name: Fixed deviation status vocabulary
description: Status values limited to Unapproved, Approved, Resolved, Waived.

assertions.check: Every deviation entry's Status column is one of the four allowed values.

name: Deviation record schema
description: Repository, Standard violated, Location, Description, Status, Risk, Remediation, Owner, Ticket fields required per entry.

assertions.check: Each DEV-NNN entry populates all required schema fields.

name: Scaffolded csproj required properties
description: TargetFramework, Nullable=enable, ImplicitUsings=enable, TreatWarningsAsErrors=true required in generated csproj.

assertions.check: Generated .csproj sets TargetFramework, Nullable=enable, ImplicitUsings=enable, TreatWarningsAsErrors=true.

name: Scaffolded appsettings.json has no secrets
description: appsettings.json stub must contain no connection strings/secrets/env-specific values.

assertions.check: Generated appsettings.json contains no ConnectionStrings section or secret-shaped values.

name: Domain command contract shape
description: Commands must be sealed record; include Audit? Audit; include CurrentDateTimeUtc when time-dependent; mandatory inputs marked required; naming pattern Create{Entity}Command/{Action}{Entity}Command; no framework service deps; no exceptions thrown from commands.

assertions.check: Command types are sealed record, declare Audit? Audit, use required on mandatory members, follow the naming pattern, and contain no throw statements.

name: Domain entity data shape
description: *EntityData must be record with required+init properties; must include CreatedDateTime/UpdatedDateTime/status enum; no behavioral methods; infrastructure-agnostic.

assertions.check: *EntityData types are record with required+init properties including CreatedDateTime, UpdatedDateTime, and a status enum; contain no method members besides compiler-generated ones.

name: Domain code never throws for business outcomes
description: Domain code must never throw exceptions for business/validation outcomes; only permitted throw is ArgumentOutOfRangeException in the exhaustive switch default of CreateEventData.
remediation: Return a DomainEntityOperationResult failure outcome instead of throwing.

assertions.check: Every `throw` statement in the *.Domain project is either absent or is an ArgumentOutOfRangeException inside the default arm of an exhaustive switch in CreateEventData.

name: Entity IDs use GenerateDeterministicId
description: Entity IDs must use PP.Framework.DDD.v2.Helpers.GuidGenerator.GenerateDeterministicId, never Guid.NewGuid() for the primary entity ID.

assertions.check: No call to Guid.NewGuid() used to assign a primary entity ID in Create methods within the Domain project.

name: CreateEventData exhaustive with Audit and Version
description: CreateEventData must exhaustively switch and include Audit+Version = EntityVersion in every payload; only permitted throw is the ArgumentOutOfRangeException default arm.

assertions.check: Every case arm of CreateEventData's switch sets Audit and Version = EntityVersion on the constructed event; the switch is exhaustive.

name: Value objects are sealed record, init-only, no throwing factories
description: Value objects are sealed record; no mutable set properties; no exceptions thrown from factories (use (bool IsValid, T? Value, string? Error) tuple pattern); no persistence IDs.

assertions.check: Value object types are sealed record with init-only properties (no `set;`); static factory methods return a tuple rather than throwing; no persistence ID property present.

name: Entity state mutated only via immutable with-updates
description: Entity state mutated only via immutable with updates on EntityData.

assertions.check: No direct field/property assignment mutates EntityData in place; mutation occurs via `with` expressions producing a new instance.

name: Application handlers are sealed partial with HandleAsync
description: Handlers must be sealed partial classes with a HandleAsync entry point.

assertions.check: Handler classes are declared `sealed partial class` and expose a `HandleAsync` method.

name: Structured logs use LoggerMessage partials
description: [LoggerMessage] partials used for structured logs, not ad hoc logger.Log*(...) interpolation.

assertions.check: No direct logger.LogInformation/LogWarning/etc. calls with interpolated strings; logging goes through [LoggerMessage] source-generated partial methods.

name: Handlers use TimeProvider, not DateTime.UtcNow
description: Handler time obtained via TimeProvider; direct DateTime.UtcNow forbidden in application handlers.

assertions.check: No DateTime.UtcNow reference inside Handlers/ folder of *.Application projects.

name: Application layer is persistence-agnostic
description: *.Application remains persistence-agnostic: no direct DbContext/EF Core references.

assertions.check: No DbContext type or Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore usage inside *.Application project files.

name: Application DI registration pattern
description: Extension-class registration; TimeProvider registered once; options via AddOptions().Bind().ValidateDataAnnotations().ValidateOnStart().

assertions.check: TimeProvider registered exactly once across the composition root; option registrations chain AddOptions().Bind().ValidateDataAnnotations().ValidateOnStart().

name: No manual validation filter re-implementing built-in validation
description: Use built-in Minimal API validation, not a manual IEndpointFilter re-implementing Validator.TryValidateObject.

assertions.check: No custom IEndpointFilter implementation that calls Validator.TryValidateObject.

name: ID derivation only in domain Create
description: Idempotency-key/deterministic-ID derivation must NOT occur in the handler or mapper -- only in domain Create(...).

assertions.check: No call to GuidGenerator.GenerateDeterministicId (or equivalent ID-derivation API) inside Handlers/ or Mappers/ folders of *.Application.

name: Handlers use a single generic catch block
description: Single generic catch (Exception ex) block; handlers must contain no validation logic.

assertions.check: HandleAsync method bodies contain at most one catch block, typed `catch (Exception ex)`.

name: No raw HttpClient in application HTTP calls
description: Must use IHttpRequestSender/HttpRequestBuilder, never raw HttpClient; mandatory retry+circuit-breaker+timeout policies.

assertions.check: No `new HttpClient(` instantiation in *.Application; typed clients configure .WithRetryPolicy and .WithCircuitBreakerPolicy.

name: Application schema attribute rules
description: Request records use [Required]+DataAnnotations only (never required keyword) with a default value; response records use required+init with no DataAnnotations; schema records forbid [StringLength]/[Range]/[MinLength]/[RegularExpression]; *.Schemas has zero NuGet references.

assertions.check: Request record properties never use the `required` keyword and carry a default value with [Required]; response record properties use `required`+`init` with no DataAnnotations; no forbidden validation attributes present; *.Schemas.csproj has zero PackageReference entries.

name: Mandatory SppWebApplication bootstrap
description: Mandatory bootstrap via SppWebApplication.CreateBuilder(...)/BuildApp(...), never WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args)/builder.Build(); must call app.UseHealthChecks() after endpoint mapping.

assertions.check: Program.cs calls SppWebApplication.CreateBuilder/.BuildApp instead of WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args)/builder.Build(); app.UseHealthChecks() is called after endpoint mapping.

name: AddValidation() required, no custom validation filters
description: .NET 10+ only; must call builder.Services.AddValidation(); forbid custom IEndpointFilter re-implementing standard validation; forbid 422 for standard validation failures; forbid constraint annotations beyond [Required] on schema records.

assertions.check: builder.Services.AddValidation() is called; no custom IEndpointFilter reimplements TryValidateObject; standard validation failures return 400, not 422.

name: Entity and event documents share partition key shape
description: Cosmos entity and event documents must use the same partition key shape.

assertions.check: The partition key builder invoked by the entity document and the event document for the same aggregate produce the same key shape/arguments.

name: Entity/event document contracts in separate files
description: Entity/event contracts maintained in separate *EntityDocument.cs/*EventDocument.cs files.

assertions.check: *EntityDocument and *EventDocument types are declared in separate files matching their names.

name: Document partition key JsonIgnore, TTL default, no Id override
description: Partition key must be [JsonIgnore]; entity docs Ttl => -1 unless business expiry defined; must not override non-virtual base members like Id.

assertions.check: Partition key property carries [JsonIgnore]; Ttl defaults to -1 unless overridden intentionally; no `override` keyword on non-virtual base members named Id.

name: Persistence factory conventions
description: Factory class marked [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]; must map from the entity's current EntityData/EntityVersion, not from commands; event documents derived only from entity.NewEvents.

assertions.check: Factory classes carry [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]; factory methods read from entity.EntityData/EntityVersion, not from *Command types; event documents are constructed only from entity.NewEvents.

name: Dedicated static partition key builder per aggregate
description: Dedicated static builder class per aggregate, [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]; no partition-key building inline elsewhere.

assertions.check: Exactly one static PartitionKeyBuilder-style class per aggregate, carrying [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]; no PartitionKey(...) construction occurs outside that class.

name: Cosmos repository registration lifetime and timeouts
description: Cosmos repositories registered as Singleton (never scoped/transient); WithRequestTimeout(30s)/WithThrottlingRetryOptions(30s,3) explicit values.

assertions.check: Cosmos repository DI registrations use AddSingleton; WithRequestTimeout and WithThrottlingRetryOptions are set to the documented values.

name: Repository inherits DomainEntityRepository<>, sealed, singleton
description: Repository must inherit DomainEntityRepository<>, registered singleton, sealed; interface may be empty extending IDomainEntityRepository<...>; forbid wrapper methods duplicating inherited base methods; forbid single-argument VersionedEntityData<T> construction.

assertions.check: Repository classes are sealed, derive from DomainEntityRepository<>, and registered singleton; no VersionedEntityData<T> construction uses the single-argument constructor overload.

name: SQL parameter binding uses DBNull.Value
description: SQL repositories bind parameters explicitly and use DBNull.Value for nulls, not raw null assignment.

assertions.check: SqlParameter.Value assignments for nullable inputs use DBNull.Value rather than a raw `null` literal.

name: Reporting handlers use ReportingSearchExecutor
description: Handlers are sealed partial with a single HandleAsync; must use ReportingSearchExecutor.ExecuteAsync (no hand-rolled activity/try-catch/logging boilerplate); handlers registered Scoped (never singleton).

assertions.check: Handler classes are sealed partial with a single HandleAsync; the body delegates to ReportingSearchExecutor.ExecuteAsync rather than hand-rolled try/catch/logging; DI registration uses AddScoped.

name: Paged responses include Page/PageSize/TotalRecords
description: Paged responses must include Page/PageSize/TotalRecords; TotalRecords from persistence layer only, never client-computed; PageSize upper bound enforced.

assertions.check: Search response records declare Page, PageSize, and TotalRecords properties; TotalRecords is populated from a persistence-layer value, not computed client-side; PageSize has a documented maximum enforced.

name: Reporting.Schemas has zero NuGet/project references
description: Contracts live in *.Reporting.Schemas with zero NuGet/project references.

assertions.check: *.Reporting.Schemas.csproj has zero PackageReference and zero ProjectReference entries.

name: Reporting date/time surrogate ID conventions
description: yyyyMMdd date IDs, seconds-since-midnight time IDs; must convert to UTC before formatting; helpers pure/static; reverse conversion returns null (not throw) when incomplete.

assertions.check: Date surrogate values match ^[0-9]{8}$ (yyyyMMdd); time surrogate values are integer seconds since midnight; conversion helpers are static and pure; reverse-conversion returns null rather than throwing on incomplete input.

name: Mandatory ReportingDbUpHost bootstrap
description: Mandatory bootstrap via ReportingDbUpHost.CreateDefaultDbUpHostBuilder<Program> (forbid hand-rolled DeployChanges.To.SqlDatabase); scripts copied via <Content> not <EmbeddedResource>; DDL only in Prod/RunOnce, procs in Prod/RunAlways using CREATE OR ALTER; deterministic script name prefixes (Script001_ etc.); no direct dbup-core/dbup-sqlserver package refs.

assertions.check: DbUp host bootstrap uses ReportingDbUpHost.CreateDefaultDbUpHostBuilder<Program>, not DeployChanges.To.SqlDatabase directly; SQL scripts are included via <Content> build action; stored procedure scripts use CREATE OR ALTER; script filenames match ^Script[0-9]{3}_; no direct dbup-core/dbup-sqlserver PackageReference.

name: Reporting event handler calls processor directly
description: Handler must call the processor's ProcessAsync directly, not construct a bespoke input wrapper; shared MapEventRoute extension defined once and reused.

assertions.check: Handler calls ProcessAsync on the shared processor type rather than constructing a custom *PersistenceProcessorInput wrapper class per handler.

name: Mandatory ReportingPersistenceProcessorBase derivation
description: Mandatory derivation from ReportingPersistenceProcessorBase<TModel> (forbid hand-rolled try/catch/retry classification); retryable SqlException maps to HTTP 500, non-retryable to HTTP 200 ack.

assertions.check: Persistence processor classes derive from ReportingPersistenceProcessorBase<TModel> rather than implementing their own try/catch/retry classification logic.

name: Reporting requirements.json structural rules
description: clientId must be looked up via az ad app show, never copied across environments; WUK environments (preprodwuk/prodwuk) must NOT have DbUp pre-app.json entries; deploymentType: job mandatory on the DbUp component only; reporting components never added to base/app.json.

assertions.check: preprodwuk/prodwuk pre-app.json files contain no DbUp component entry; the DbUp component's deploymentType is "job"; base/app.json contains no reporting component entries.

name: Reporting SQL repository conventions
description: Every method logs LogDebug with structured params before execution; specific DBNull.Value binding rules by source type; search methods read TotalRecords first then paged rows via IsDBNullAsync (never synchronous IsDBNull); one stored procedure per method matching name.

assertions.check: Each repository method begins with a LogDebug call including structured parameters; async reads use IsDBNullAsync, never the synchronous IsDBNull; each method maps 1:1 to a single stored procedure name.

name: EventId reservation blocks non-collision
description: EventId reservation blocks enforced per entity/component (e.g. 3000-3099/3100-3199 per entity; 4000-4099 for persistence processor).

assertions.check: Extracted [LoggerMessage(EventId = N)] values fall within the reserved numeric block for their component and contain no collisions across the codebase.

name: EventHandler outbound calls use typed adapters
description: Outbound calls use typed adapters + PP.Framework.Http abstractions (no raw HttpClient).

assertions.check: No `new HttpClient(` instantiation in *.EventHandler.Application adapters.

name: Shared Telemetry folder with required files
description: Shared Telemetry/ folder exists with MetricNames, TagNames, MetricExtensions.

assertions.check: Telemetry/ folder exists containing MetricNames, TagNames, and MetricExtensions files.

name: EventHandler mandatory SppWebApplication bootstrap
description: Mandatory SppWebApplication.CreateBuilder(...)/BuildApp(...) -- never raw WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args)/builder.Build().

assertions.check: Program.cs calls SppWebApplication.CreateBuilder/.BuildApp instead of WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args)/builder.Build().

name: EventHandler HTTP client uses IHttpRequestSender with resilience policies
description: Must use IHttpRequestSender/HttpRequestBuilder/HttpResponseSuccess<T>, never raw HttpClient; must include retry+circuit-breaker policies.

assertions.check: No raw HttpClient usage; IHttpRequestSender/HttpRequestBuilder used with .WithRetryPolicy and .WithCircuitBreakerPolicy configured.

name: EventHandler fixed error response contract
description: Null/invalid payload -> BadRequest; downstream failure -> Problem 500; unhandled exception -> Problem 500 (never Ok on these paths, except a documented swallow-and-acknowledge exception).

assertions.check: Handler code paths for null/invalid payload, downstream failure, and unhandled exception return BadRequest/Problem(500) respectively, never Ok, unless annotated with a documented swallow-and-acknowledge comment.

name: EventHandler tests cover all non-success HTTP status codes
description: Naming MethodName_Should_ExpectedBehavior_WhenCondition; required coverage of all non-success HTTP status codes (400/401/403/404/422/429/500/503/504) per HTTP client method.

assertions.check: Test method identifiers match ^[A-Za-z0-9]+_Should_[A-Za-z0-9]+_When[A-Za-z0-9]+$; a test exists exercising each of 400/401/403/404/422/429/500/503/504 per HTTP client method.

name: FPE calls use CancellationToken and batch APIs
description: Use IFpeService/AddFpeService(...) by default; async calls must propagate CancellationToken; use batch APIs for collections instead of looping single calls.

assertions.check: FPE service calls accept and propagate a CancellationToken; no loop repeatedly calling a single-item FPE encrypt/decrypt method when a batch overload exists.

name: No raw OpenTelemetry SDK wiring
description: Forbids raw OpenTelemetry SDK wiring (new Meter(...), new ActivitySource(...), .AddOpenTelemetry().WithTracing(...)) -- must use framework extensions instead.

assertions.check: No `new Meter(`, `new ActivitySource(`, or `.AddOpenTelemetry().WithTracing(` call sites outside PP.Framework.Instrumentation itself.

name: client_key forbidden as a metric tag
description: client_key must never be used as a metric tag (cardinality rule); use client_sector grouping instead.

assertions.check: No metric tag argument named client_key/clientKey passed to RecordMetric/StartCounterMetric or equivalent APIs.

name: Pinned Cosmos emulator image tag must not change casually
description: The pinned Cosmos emulator image tag vnext-EN20260602 must not change without validation.

assertions.check: Cosmos emulator container image tag in AppHost equals vnext-EN20260602 unless an explicit validated change is recorded.

name: AppHost secrets never hardcoded
description: Secrets never hardcoded, must use AddParameter(..., secret: true).

assertions.check: No literal secret-shaped string assigned directly in AppHost configuration; secret parameters declared via AddParameter(..., secret: true).

name: Internal service-to-service uses http scheme
description: Always use http between internal services, https only for external.

assertions.check: WithEnvironment/reference URLs between internal AppHost-managed services use the http scheme, not https.

name: typeName constants match between code and CRD YAML
description: typeName constants must match exactly between code and CRD YAML; byKeyEndpoint required for Client-scoped types; IncludeTenantContext true mandatory on forwarder; consumer registration must use ConfigurationManager not IConfiguration; FilterExpression must include all 3 CloudEvent types; forwarder ConsumerGroup must be unique.

assertions.check: The typeName string constant in code exactly matches the CRD YAML's typeName field; forwarder config sets IncludeTenantContext: true; consumer registration uses ConfigurationManager; FilterExpression lists Created, Updated, and Deleted event types; ConsumerGroup values are unique across forwarders.

name: base/app.json contains only argocd block
description: base/app.json must contain only the argocd block; Cosmos Terraform resources gated with count = var.primary_location == UK South ? 1 : 0; log level Debug for dev, Information elsewhere; never add a resources block speculatively.

assertions.check: base/app.json's only top-level key is argocd; dev environment log level is Debug and non-dev environments are Information; no speculative resources block present without a documented need.

name: Zero AutoMapper references after removal
description: Final verification gate: zero AutoMapper references after removal; build with 0 errors/warnings; tests with 0 failures.

assertions.check: grep -r "AutoMapper" across the repository returns zero matches after the migration is marked complete; dotnet build produces 0 errors/warnings; dotnet test produces 0 failures.

name: Bruno test folder/file naming conventions
description: One folder per operation with mandatory folder.bru containing seq; PascalCase folder names; human-readable file names (no numeric prefixes) using Setup -/Teardown -/Invalid  prefixes; camelCase variable names.

assertions.check: Every operation folder contains a folder.bru with a seq field; folder names are PascalCase; request filenames have no leading numeric sequence prefix and use the documented Setup -/Teardown -/Invalid  prefixes where applicable; Bruno variable names are camelCase.

name: 80% line coverage gate
description: Coverage gate >=80% line coverage (tool-enforced).

assertions.check: coverlet-reported line coverage percentage is >= 80.

name: Never log or persist the ADO PAT token
description: pps-ado-ticket-fetch must never log/persist the PAT token; output path pattern ~/changes/{REPO}/{TICKET_ID}/{TICKET_ID}.md.

assertions.check: No log line or output file contains the ADO PAT token value.

name: Confluence fetch uses Basic auth, never logs credentials
description: HTTP Basic auth (email:token), not Bearer; never log credentials.

assertions.check: Confluence requests use HTTP Basic auth, not a Bearer token header; no log line contains the credential value.

name: Event catalogue fetch forbids destructive git ops
description: Never git reset/force-checkout/merge/rebase/push against the catalogue; only pull from canonical allowed remotes.

assertions.check: No git reset --hard, checkout --force, merge, rebase, or push command is issued against the event catalogue remote/clone; remote URL matches the allow-list.

name: Automated C# standards compliance checklist
description: Naming conventions, var presence, file-scoped namespaces, no #region, async Async suffix + CancellationToken propagation, no async void (except handlers), no .Result/.Wait(), DI via extension methods, ILogger<T> not Console.WriteLine.

assertions.check: All listed pattern checks (naming, #region absence, async suffix + CancellationToken, no async void outside handlers, no blocking calls, DI extension pattern, ILogger<T> usage) pass across the file.

name: Skill description length limit
description: Skill descriptions must be <= 1024 characters; file line count < 500.

assertions.check: SKILL.md frontmatter description field is <= 1024 characters and the file has < 500 lines.

name: Local secrets agent never prints secret values
description: Never print or expose secret values -- output key names only; always verify .gitignore excludes secrets.json before any write.

assertions.check: Agent output contains only secret key names, never values; .gitignore is confirmed to exclude secrets.json before any write to that file.

name: AutoMapper removal never skips safety-net tests
description: Never skip Phase 3 (safety-net tests); always run the Phase 5b dual audit after implementation.

assertions.check: The AutoMapper-removal workflow log records that Phase 3 (safety-net tests) and the Phase 5b dual audit both executed.

name: Event catalogue reviewer never modifies code
description: Must run PP Event Catalogue Fetch before every review and record its source timestamp/local catalogue commit; never modify code or PPP.EventCatalog.

assertions.check: No file write occurs to application code or PPP.EventCatalog during a review run; the review artifact records the catalogue fetch timestamp and commit SHA.

name: Use record for DTOs/value objects
description: record types should represent DTOs and value objects.

assertions.check: Types that are structurally pure data carriers (identified heuristically: no injected dependencies, no I/O) are declared as `record`; flag non-record types matching this heuristic for review.

name: Boolean properties use affirmative Is/Has/Can naming
description: Boolean properties prefixed with Is/Has/Can, avoiding negative names like NotExpired.

assertions.check: bool properties match ^(Is|Has|Can); properties matching a negative-prefix pattern (e.g. ^Not[A-Z]) are flagged for rename review.

name: Classes sealed by default unless designed for inheritance
description: Classes should be sealed unless explicitly designed for inheritance.

assertions.check: Non-abstract classes with no derived types in the solution and no `virtual`/`protected` members are flagged if not declared `sealed`; classes with virtual members or existing derivations are exempt.

name: Interfaces follow interface segregation
description: One responsibility per interface, small/focused (ISP), prefixed I.

assertions.check: Interface name is prefixed with I (deterministic); member count above a threshold (e.g. >7) is flagged for a cohesion review (judgment required).

name: Non-nullable by default with early null validation
description: Non-nullable by default, nullable only when optional; validate nulls early (e.g. ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull).

assertions.check: Public constructor/method parameters that are reference types and non-nullable have a corresponding ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull (or equivalent) guard; completeness across all call paths requires review.

name: Catch specific exceptions, do not swallow
description: Catch specific exceptions not Exception; don't swallow exceptions; use custom domain exceptions.

assertions.check: catch blocks typed `catch (Exception)` with an empty body or no rethrow/log are flagged; whether the broader `catch (Exception ex)` usage is 'exceptional condition only' requires reviewer judgment.

name: ConfigureAwait usage depends on project type
description: ConfigureAwait(false) in libraries/console/WinForms/WPF; omitted in ASP.NET Core apps.

assertions.check: Await expressions in class-library projects include .ConfigureAwait(false); ASP.NET Core web projects are exempted; classification of a project's type must be confirmed by its SDK/output type.

name: Correct DI lifetime selection
description: Register services via extension methods; use correct lifetimes (Singleton/Scoped/Transient); register interfaces not concrete types.

assertions.check: Registrations bind an interface type to an implementation (deterministic); whether the chosen lifetime (Singleton/Scoped/Transient) is semantically correct for the service's state requires reviewer judgment.

name: Secrets stored only in Key Vault/User Secrets
description: Secrets: Azure Key Vault (prod), User Secrets (local dev), never commit secrets.

assertions.check: Secret-scanning pattern matches (API keys, connection strings, tokens) in tracked files are flagged; distinguishing a genuine secret from a benign config value requires reviewer judgment on ambiguous matches.

name: No PII or sensitive data in log messages
description: Never log sensitive/PII data (e.g. account numbers).

assertions.check: Log statements referencing known sensitive field names (AccountNumber, CardNumber, Ssn, etc.) are flagged; general PII detection beyond known field names requires reviewer judgment.

name: Avoid reflection/assembly-scanning substitute tests
description: Avoid brittle reflection/assembly-scanning tests (no type-existence-only tests).

assertions.check: Test methods using System.Reflection APIs are flagged for review to confirm they assert behavior, not merely type/member existence.

name: AAA test structure with clear separation
description: Arrange/Act/Assert pattern with comments.

assertions.check: Test methods contain // Arrange / // Act / // Assert comment markers (deterministic presence check); correct structural separation of each phase requires reviewer judgment.

name: Persistence organized by aggregate folder
description: Persistence layer organized by aggregate folder (all Cosmos artifacts for one aggregate co-located).

assertions.check: Cosmos-related types for a given aggregate (documents, repository, factory, partition key builder) reside under a common folder named after the aggregate; whether the grouping is semantically correct requires reviewer judgment.

name: Sensitive fields identified for FPE encryption
description: FPE encryption for payee account data, PII, card data (PCI-DSS); encrypt on write, decrypt only when needed.

assertions.check: Fields matching known sensitive naming patterns (AccountNumber, CardNumber, Ssn, etc.) that are persisted without an FPE call are flagged; full data-classification coverage requires reviewer judgment.

name: Event mapping switch semantic completeness
description: Event mapping switch exhaustive, includes audit/version on each event (semantic correctness beyond compiler exhaustiveness).

assertions.check: Compiler-enforced switch exhaustiveness passes (deterministic); each case's constructed event including correct Audit/Version population needs semantic review.

name: Endpoint mappings stay thin, delegate to handlers
description: Endpoint mappings stay thin, delegate to injected handlers.

assertions.check: Endpoint mapping lambda/method bodies exceeding a small statement-count threshold (e.g. >5 statements) or containing branching logic are flagged for a 'thin delegation' review.

name: EventHandler classes are thin orchestrators
description: Handler classes are thin orchestrators, no business decisions.

assertions.check: EventHandler classes with branching complexity or domain-rule-shaped conditionals above a heuristic threshold are flagged for review to confirm no business logic leaked into the handler.

name: Idempotency/dedup owned by application/domain, not event handler
description: Idempotency/dedup owned by internal application/domain layer, not event handler.

assertions.check: No idempotency-key/deduplication-store logic appears directly inside *.EventHandler.Application handler classes; confirming the responsibility is correctly located in the domain layer requires cross-layer tracing.

name: Document factory emits CloudEvents with correct tenant context
description: Document factory uses entity's current state, emits CloudEvents with correct tenant context.

assertions.check: Factory reads from entity.EntityData (deterministic); correctness of tenant-context propagation into the emitted CloudEvent requires semantic review.

name: Reporting contracts align with stored procedure signatures
description: Contracts align with stored procedure signatures/result shapes.

assertions.check: C# contract property names/types are cross-referenced against the corresponding stored procedure's parameter list and result set columns; mismatches are flagged.

name: HTTP timeout must exceed retry budget
description: Timeout must not be shorter than retries x initial delay.

assertions.check: Extracted numeric literals for retry count, initial delay, backoff multiplier, and overall timeout satisfy timeout >= retries * initial_delay (approximated for exponential backoff).

name: FPE encryption occurs before domain Create call
description: Encryption (FPE) must happen BEFORE domain Create(), never after.

assertions.check: Control-flow analysis of HandleAsync confirms the FPE encrypt call site precedes the call to the domain aggregate's Create(...) method.

name: APIM config matches service EndpointMappings and Event Catalog
description: operationId/route/schema must match the service EndpointMappings.cs and Event Catalog exactly.

assertions.check: operationId, route, and schema reference strings in the APIM config are diffed against the corresponding values in EndpointMappings.cs and the fetched Event Catalog; any mismatch is flagged.

name: All outcome branches covered by tests
description: Unit tests cover all handler outcomes/HTTP status codes/mapper edge cases.

assertions.check: Every member of the relevant outcome enum (or documented status-code set) has at least one corresponding test method name referencing it; coverage-tool output cross-referenced against enum membership.

name: SRP and composition-over-inheritance design quality
description: Classes follow Single Responsibility Principle and favor composition over inheritance.

assertions.check: AI reviewer assesses whether the class has a single, cohesive responsibility and whether inheritance is used only where composition would be inappropriate.

name: var usage judged by type obviousness
description: Use var when the type is obvious from context; use explicit type when it is not.

assertions.check: AI reviewer judges whether the right-hand-side expression makes the variable's type self-evident, and flags var usage where it does not.

name: DDD concept usage quality
description: Entities, Value Objects, Commands, Domain Events, Bounded Contexts, Ubiquitous Language used correctly.

assertions.check: AI reviewer assesses whether the domain model reflects rich DDD concepts rather than an anemic data-holder pattern.

name: Auth architecture least-privilege soundness
description: Auth via Azure AD/Entra ID, validate JWT tokens, least privilege.

assertions.check: Human security reviewer confirms the auth design follows least-privilege and does not introduce excessive scope grants.

name: PCI-DSS scope and compliance judgment
description: PCI-DSS scope considered for payment data flows; compliance audits every deployment.

assertions.check: Human compliance reviewer classifies whether a given data flow falls within PCI-DSS scope and whether existing controls are adequate.

name: Log level appropriateness for a statement
description: Log level usage table (Trace/Debug/Information/Warning/Error/Critical) applied appropriately.

assertions.check: AI reviewer judges whether the chosen log level matches the severity/frequency of the event being logged.

name: Test pyramid ratio (many unit, few integration)
description: Test pyramid: many unit tests, few integration tests.

assertions.check: AI reviewer compares unit-vs-integration test counts and flags disproportionate integration-test growth relative to unit tests.

name: Test determinism and independence
description: Deterministic execution, order-independence, no shared mutable state across tests.

assertions.check: AI/human reviewer runs the suite in randomized order and inspects for shared static/mutable state; flakiness generally requires execution, not static analysis alone.

name: Value objects represent domain concepts, not transport identity
description: Value objects represent domain concepts not transport/persistence identity.

assertions.check: AI reviewer judges whether a given value object encodes a genuine domain concept versus merely wrapping a transport/persistence identifier.

name: Architecture assessment ADR/narrative quality
description: Architecture Reviewer produces ADR-quality recommendations and migration paths.

assertions.check: Human reviewer assesses the quality, clarity, and actionability of the generated architecture assessment narrative.

name: FPE integration mode matches use case
description: Chosen FPE integration mode (service API vs source-generator) matches use case.

assertions.check: AI reviewer judges whether IFpeService (runtime) or the [FpeEncryptable] source-generator mode is the better fit for the call site's shape and volume.

name: AutoMapper removal effort/risk estimation quality
description: Impact assessment, feasibility, and effort estimation judgment during AutoMapper removal.

assertions.check: Human reviewer validates the agent's stated effort/risk estimate against actual usage scope discovered in Phase 0 inventory.

name: Service characteristic classification for template selection
description: Classifying a new service's characteristics against the pps-template-selection decision tree.

assertions.check: AI reviewer/engineer confirms the yes/no answers fed into the (deterministic) decision tree correctly describe the new service.

name: SAST/secret-scan heuristic false-positive triage
description: Judgment on adequacy of secret-scanning heuristics and SAST pattern true/false-positive triage.

assertions.check: Human reviewer triages each SAST/secret-scan grep hit to confirm it is a true positive requiring remediation rather than a benign pattern match.

name: Runbook and alert coverage adequacy
description: Alert definitions/runbooks quality and completeness in requirements/ and docs/.

assertions.check: Human on-call reviewer confirms runbooks cover the failure modes actually observed/expected for the service and that alerts map to them.
